statement: Between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-30, the IRGC or Iranian forces strike or seize at least one additional commercial tanker in or near the Strait of Hormuz.
resolution: True if Reuters, AP, or UKMTO reports at least one new tanker strike or seizure by Iranian forces near Hormuz dated between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No Iranian strike or seizure of a commercial tanker near Hormuz occurs between 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-30.

statement: Brent crude front-month settles above 100 USD per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 94.80 on the packet date.
resolution: True if ICE Brent front-month daily settlement exceeds 100.00 USD on any trading day from 2026-11-10 to 2026-12-31. Reference: 94.80 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Brent front-month settlement stays at or below 100.00 USD on every trading day between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.

statement: A formal ceasefire or comprehensive peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine is signed by both governments between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: True if Russia and Ukraine both sign a ceasefire or peace agreement between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31, as reported by Reuters and AP.
failure_condition: No ceasefire or peace agreement is signed by both Russia and Ukraine between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31.

statement: Jensen Huang ceases to be CEO of Nvidia, via resignation, removal, or announced leave, between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: True if Nvidia files an SEC 8-K or issues a press release between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31 stating Huang has resigned, been removed, or taken leave as CEO.
failure_condition: Jensen Huang remains Nvidia CEO without announced leave through 2027-01-31.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds an OpenSSH vulnerability with a date-added value between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog lists an OpenSSH CVE with dateAdded between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-15.
failure_condition: No OpenSSH CVE carries a KEV dateAdded value between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-15.

statement: The US 10-year Treasury yield closes above 5.00 percent on at least one day between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.88 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DGS10 shows a value above 5.00 for any date from 2026-11-10 to 2026-12-31. Reference: 4.88 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: DGS10 stays at or below 5.00 on every date between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The EU formally nominates or agrees on a new ECB President candidate between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if the Eurogroup or European Council publicly names its chosen candidate for ECB President between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31, per official EU press release.
failure_condition: No candidate for ECB President is formally chosen by the Eurogroup or European Council between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.

statement: A US federal government funding lapse (shutdown) begins between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: True if federal appropriations lapse and OMB directs a shutdown of agencies on any date between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31, per Congress.gov and wire reporting.
failure_condition: No lapse in federal appropriations occurs between 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-31.

statement: USGS records an earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater within 300 km of the Solomon Islands between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: True if the USGS earthquake catalog lists an M7.0+ event within 300 km of Lata or Honiara with an origin time between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: No M7.0+ earthquake within 300 km of the Solomon Islands occurs between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Polish prosecutors publicly announce a motive or ideological link for the Krakow shooting between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-10.
resolution: True if Polish prosecutors or police publicly state a determined motive for the Krakow gunman between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-10, as reported by BBC or Reuters.
failure_condition: Polish authorities do not state a determined motive for the Krakow shooting between 2026-11-10 and 2026-12-10.
